kraken_order_amend.rationale: Amends a live order in place. An amend can raise size, so it is graded as placement rather than as a cancel.

kraken_order_batch.rationale: Submits 2-15 live orders in one call.

kraken_order_buy.rationale: Places a live buy order committing funds at market.

kraken_order_cancel.rationale: Cancels one open order by txid, userref, or client order ID. Nothing is bought, sold, or transferred, and committed exposure can only fall. Governed so an agent signer can rate-limit churn and check that a cancelled protective stop is replaced; paging a human to cancel an order during a market move costs availability and buys no judgment.

kraken_order_cancel_after.rationale: Dead man's switch — arms automatic cancellation of all orders after a timeout. Risk-reducing in effect, but it is a standing rule that fires later with nobody present.

kraken_order_cancel_all.rationale: Cancels every open order. Risk-reducing and no funds move, but account-wide: it removes protective stops together with entries.

kraken_order_cancel_batch.rationale: Cancels an enumerated batch of up to 50 orders. Bounded by the ids supplied and no funds move; graded with the single cancel it repeats.

kraken_order_edit.rationale: Cancel-and-replace on a live order. The replacement can raise size, so it is graded as placement.

kraken_withdrawal_cancel.rationale: Cancels a pending withdrawal. Risk-reducing in the strict sense — it is the only operation in this plugin that stops funds leaving. Grading it alongside kraken_withdraw inverted the ladder, making the brake as hard to approve as the accelerator.
